//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Conduits Prevent Drowned -> Config

Enable Conduits Prevent Drowned.//: Whether Conduits Prevent Drowned is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

preventDrownedInRange.//: The euclidian distance range around the drowned where a check for a player with the conduit effect is done. A value of 400 prevents the spawning of all drowned around. min: 0, max: 400
